description: This file defines the login page component for a Remix-based React application. It includes loader and action functions to handle server-side authentication logic and a React component that renders the login form, displaying errors and managing form submission states.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the current user based on the request; redirects to /notes if authenticated.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles login form submission, calls backend API to authenticate, redirects on success, or returns error message.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React component rendering the login form, error messages, and handling UI state during submission.
